    94→<div class="class-content">
    95→<h2 class="hy-p-50">Hot Vinyasa</h2>
    96→<p>This dynamic class is practiced in a heated room, with poses done in quick succession to promote endurance, strength, and stability.</p>
    97→</div>
    98→</div>
    99→</article>

   105→<div class="class-content">
   106→<h2 class="hy-p-50">Prenatal</h2>
   107→<p>Nurture yourself in this sacred space, focused on lower back and hip release, breathwork, and other labor-preparing exercises.</p>
   108→</div>

   117→<h2 class="hy-p-50">Postnatal</h2>
   118→<p>With an eye on recovery and restoration, post-natal yoga eases stress and alleviates discomfort following childbirth.</p>

   128→<h2 class="hy-p-50">Restorative</h2>
   129→<p>With longer asanas and deeper breathing, restorative yoga helps the body rest, heal, and restore balance.</p>
